description: **Fix.** Restore path-based changelog-only commit exemption alongside the Autogenerated trailer check. Manual commits touching only .rlsbl/changes/ or CHANGELOG.md are now correctly skipped during coverage validation.

**New feature.** Auto-sync lockfiles during release. After version bump, rlsbl detects uv.lock, package-lock.json, and go.sum, runs the appropriate sync command, and includes modified lockfiles in the release commit.
